description: Small hand-labelled pilot set for EvidenceGraph AI. 6 categories x 4 questions, grounded ONLY in the committed fixtures (data/sample/advisories.json, 5 CISA KEV records; data/sample/nvd_sample.json, 1 NVD record for CVE-2021-44228).
scope_note: This is a PILOT, not a benchmark. 24 questions over a 6-record corpus cannot support generalizable claims. It is sized to exercise every evaluation category end to end and to make the harness and metrics runnable and reproducible.

questions.question: Which product does CVE-2018-13379 affect?

gold_claims.text: CVE-2018-13379 affects Fortinet FortiOS.

questions.question: What type of vulnerability is CVE-2023-34362?

gold_claims.text: CVE-2023-34362 is a SQL injection vulnerability.

questions.question: On what date was CVE-2021-44228 added to the catalog?
What weakness class is associated with CVE-2014-0160?

gold_claims.text: CVE-2014-0160 is an information disclosure weakness in OpenSSL.

questions.question: Which cataloged vulnerabilities were added on 2021-11-03?
Which cataloged products are affected by remote code execution vulnerabilities?

gold_claims.text: Apache Log4j2 is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.
Microsoft Exchange Server is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.
Fortinet FortiOS is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.

questions.question: Which cataloged vulnerabilities are flagged as known ransomware campaign use and were added in 2021?

CVE-2021-34473 has known ransomware campaign use.
CVE-2014-0160 has known ransomware campaign use.

CVE-2021-34473 is a remote code execution vulnerability.
Both vulnerabilities are the same class.
